notes.title: Demo Update: Gallery App Added
notes.notes:
The new demo update adds another app - the Gallery!



Most visual novels have an image galley of some sort, but with Winter Heat's app system, you can expand the story and learn more about the lives of Javi and Shio through the Gallery. Not only will you unlock beautiful art from the main game by director and lead artist Fruz, but you'll get more art and photographs of daily life in Chile and Japan, divided up by different folders across time and topic. Discover an even richer story through the Gallery in the full game. And now it's in the demo, too, mainly to demonstrate what's coming soon.



The next demo update will hopefully include a sizeable update to the Oomfie RPG sub-game, as well as the Maps app. We're trying to get the demo as far along as possible before the end of the Kickstarter campaign, which still has about two weeks remaining. We're shooting for some cool stretch goals, so please support by pledging or sharing!

notes.title: Demo Update: New App - Test Your English!
notes.notes:
As part of our weekly content updates throughout the Winter Heat Kickstarter campaign, we've added a new app to the demo experience-- Test Your English!

It's only a couple minutes long, to demonstrate the type of gameplay you can look forward to in the full release. This is the app that Shio uses every day to train up her English level so she can communicate more effectively with people from around the world. How will YOU do?

Give us your feedback on this app and especially ideas for extremely silly English language questions. Just yesterday, we reached our stretch goal to expand this app into an even bigger experience, so please look forward to that!



There are a few other smaller updates to the demo, but mostly under the hood so the game doesn't break later down the line. 



See you next week!
